payload.resumeText:
Name: Alex Morgan
Email: alex.morgan@example.com
City: Example City, Country
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/alex-morgan-example
GitHub: github.com/alex-morgan-example
Portfolio: alex-morgan.example.com

Professional summary:
Software engineer with a background in data analysis and backend services. Builds REST APIs, containerised deployments, and small open-source tools. Seeking an applied engineering role in machine learning.

Education:
- Degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science | Institution: Example State University | Year: 2020 – 2024 | Coursework: Algorithms, Databases, Machine Learning, Operating Systems

Experience:
- Role: Data Analyst Intern | Company: Sample Analytics Ltd. | Dates: 2023 – 2024 | Details: Completed a six-month analytics internship.
Analysed sales data with Pandas and NumPy and produced weekly reports for the operations team.
Wrote SQL queries for reporting dashboards.

Skills:
- Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript, Java
- Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask, Express.js
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite
- Tools: Linux, Git, Docker, pandas, scikit-learn

Projects:
- Title: Example CLI Toolkit | Technologies: Python, Linux CLI, packaging | Link: github.com/alex-morgan-example/cli-toolkit | Details: Published an open-source command-line utility with automated tests and documentation.
- Title: Malware Classifier Prototype | Technologies: Python, FastAPI, XGBoost, Docker | Link: github.com/alex-morgan-example/classifier | Details: Trained a classifier on file-header features and served predictions through a REST API.

Certifications:
- Name: Introductory Machine Learning Course | Issuer: Example Online Academy | Year: 2023

Achievements:
- Title: Regional programming contest | Details: Placed in the top ten teams.
payload.jobDescription: Target job title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer
